Transform your standing desk into a wellness tool with Stao — your personal sit-stand timer and break reminder for healthier workdays. Whether you work from home or in an office, Stao helps you build sustainable habits that reduce back pain and boost energy.

WHY STAO?

Owning a standing desk is just the first step. The real health benefits come from alternating between sitting, standing, and movement breaks. Stao helps you build this habit effortlessly.

Studies show that alternating positions throughout the day reduces fatigue, improves focus, and prevents ergonomic issues.

KEY FEATURES

◆ Smart Sit-Stand Reminders
Customizable timers remind you when to change positions. Set your own intervals or use recommended durations based on ergonomic research.

◆ Movement Breaks
Get gentle nudges to step away, stretch, or take a short walk. Combat the sedentary lifestyle one break at a time.

◆ Transition Stretches
When it's time to switch positions, get a quick stretch suggestion with illustrated guides. 12 office-friendly exercises help you stay loose — no equipment needed.

◆ Clean, Calming Design
A warm, minimal interface that doesn't distract from your work. No clutter — just a beautiful timer that fits your workflow.

◆ Flexible Scheduling
Pause during meetings, adjust timers on the fly, or set quiet hours. Stao adapts to your workday.

◆ Progress Tracking
See your daily sit, stand, and movement stats. Build streaks and stay motivated.

◆ Live Activities & Dynamic Island
Track your session from your Lock Screen or Dynamic Island. Always know your standing desk progress at a glance — no other break timer offers this.

WHAT MAKES STAO DIFFERENT?

Unlike free break timers that haven't been updated in years, Stao is actively developed with modern iOS features:

• Live Activities & Dynamic Island — see your timer without opening the app
• Privacy First — no account required, your data stays on your device
• Works Offline — no internet needed, your timer runs reliably
• Beautiful Design — warm, calming aesthetics that reduce stress
• 9 Languages — English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Norwegian, Dutch, Portuguese, Swedish

HEALTH BENEFITS

Alternating between sitting and standing can:
• Reduce back and neck pain
• Improve posture and circulation
• Boost energy and focus during work
• Lower risk of sedentary-related health issues

quotes.text:
I built something embarrasingly simple. It changed my workday. When COVID began and I started working from home, I as many others, bought a standing desk. $500, height memory, digital display, the works.

How much did I actually stand? Maybe 15-20 minutes a day. I just kept forgetting.

- Tried phone alarms, annoying, started dismissing them without thinking.
- Tried sticky notes, lasted 2 days.
- Tried "I'll just remember", never worked.

So I built Stao. It's a timer that reminds you to switch positions. That's basically it.

I use the 20-8-2 pattern: 20 min sitting, 8 min standing, 2 min moving around (grab water, stretch, whatever). Short cycles so you never get stiff. There's also a 45-15 mode if you want longer focus blocks.

After a month my back feels noticeably better and the 3pm energy crash is gone.

What it does:
- Timer with customizable sit/stand/move intervals
- Gentle notifications when it's time to switch
- Tracks your daily/weekly standing time
- Lives in system tray on desktop (if not using the mobile apps), doesn't get in the way

What it doesn't do:
- No account required
- No cloud sync (all data stays on device), however I might add this in the not too distant future
- No social features, gamification, or AI nonsense

Tech stack: Flutter for cross-platform (yes, even desktop). Hive for local storage. Native integrations for system tray and notifications. No backend.

Available on Mac/Windows/Linux/iOS. Android is in beta testing.
